rubric.CORRECT: Requested source facts and material status distinctions correct; permitted unknowns preserved.
rubric.WRONG: Material false claim, wrong object/version, or missed critical update.
rubric.QUALIFIED: Main requested state is largely right but a secondary detail/inventory item is missing, ambiguous or unsupported; kept separate from full success.
rubric.UNFULFILLED: Accepted final response does not provide the requested answer despite task scope.
rubric.FAILED: No accepted final answer; first failure receipt retained.
